items.note: Profile form inside an outlined raised card under the teal band. A red-bordered summary at the top says 'Fix 2 fields below to save your profile'. Full name and email have danger borders, and each has an alert icon with an ink message that says what to do. The focused empty field shows the ring. There is one pink 'Save changes' and a ghost 'Reset'.

Same error state on the black ground with a dark raised card. The summary and field danger borders are still visible, the messages are light and readable, and the focused field has the pink halo. One pink save, with an outlined Reset beside it.

One-column form under a collapsed teal band, with a scrolling pill strip where 'Profile' is selected. The error summary wraps cleanly and the field errors sit right under their inputs with icon plus words. The submit row stays in the flow.

After saving, a 'Saved' chip with a pink check circle and a hard offset shadow appears inline after 'Save changes' (still lifted under the pointer) and 'Reset'. It is not a bottom-left toast, and it reads like a third button.

Same inline 'Saved' chip in dark, with a light hard shadow. The fields show the saved values and the pink save stays the only pink action. The confirmation is again inline and shaped like a lifted button, not a toast.

On mobile the 'Saved' chip wraps under the save row, with the pink check and hard shadow. The message is clear, but the chip is placed inline and styled like a button instead of the full-width bottom toast.

Confirm dialog 'Switch to the Business plan?' on a raised panel with ink border and hard shadow. It has a close icon button, one line of consequence, a ghost Cancel and a pink 'Confirm change', aligned right. The plan cards behind it use ghost buttons, so only one pink action shows. The scrim covering only the first viewport comes from the full-page capture.
Same dialog in dark: a dark raised panel with a light border and light hard shadow over a darkened page, readable body text, an outlined Cancel and one pink confirm.

The dialog goes near full width with 16px margins. The title wraps beside the close button, and the full-width pink 'Confirm change' sits above the full-width outlined Cancel. The hard shadow is visible and nothing is cut off.

'Change password' card with a summary 'Fix 1 field below to update your password'. New password shows a green check with 'Strength: Strong'. The focused confirm field has a danger border and pink halo with 'Passwords do not match.' under it. One pink 'Update password'; the session table's Revoke buttons are outlined.

Dark version keeps the summary box, the green strength line with its icon, the pink-haloed mismatch field with its alert message and one pink submit. The sessions table below is readable, with outlined Revoke actions.

One-column form with the wrapped summary, the strength line, the mismatch error under the confirm field and the pink submit in the flow. The sessions table below still hides Last active and Revoke behind sideways scroll; that was raised in the earlier round and is not raised again.

Notifications screen: the focused 'Notifications' pill in the band has a clear 2px ink outline at an offset around its raised fill. The switches below show ink tracks when on, each next to an On/Off word, inside outlined cards with hairline rules.
In dark, the focused pill is paper-filled with a visible outline ring on the teal band. Switches are paper tracks with On/Off words, and the count badge '3 of 6 notifications on' is readable.

On mobile the band's pill strip scrolls. The pill next to the selected one shows only the side arcs of its focus ring because the strip clips it top and bottom; that was raised in the earlier round. Switches are ink with On/Off words, full width.

findings.summary: The save confirmation appears as an inline chip after the form buttons, with the button's border and hard shadow, not as the fixed bottom-left toast. Next to a lifted save button it reads as a third button, not as a status message.
